East Tender Optoelectronics.why: Upstream maker of thin-film optical filters (DWDM, CWDM, band-pass, edge filters) for optical transceivers and PON; it co-developed 400G and 800G transmission-module filters with customers and is developing filters for 800G/1.6T modules and CPO/LPO, so optical-module demand drives its revenue.
East Tender Optoelectronics.evidence: East Tender Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026): the company's products are thin-film optical filters for optical communications; it worked with customers to develop 400G and 800G transmission modules, 25G PON and 50G PON applications; it is investing in R&D on filters for 800G/1.6T optical modules and extending into CPO/LPO.
